featured_reviews.name: Geeta Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
VERY VERY VERY BAD EXPERIENCE! RUDE PERSON CALLED KARTIK AT THE BANDRA/ KHAR OFFICE!
I was not at home to receive the flowers. A guy called Hanif called, at least that's the name he gave me. I said I would be back in 2 hours. I also informed that we are not supposed to leave any parcels with the security guard or the neighbor. Yet, in-spite of my saying so, the flowers were left there.
I called up to find out when he would come again. Hanif said his boss told him to leave the flowers with the security guard and leave. He asked his office to call me. No call was made to me from their office. finally I git the number from Hanif and called Kartik.
This man was not willing to listen or understand our dilemma.
Instead he was rude.
He started shouting and said to tell my people in USA whatever I want.
I asked for his Superior's number, and he refused to give it to me.
I asked for the name of his Boss, and first he said his boss in in Delhi and later he refused again.
I asked for their website, he said he didn't know the website. I asked him for his name he said - the name you used. I asked him for his complete name- He said its Kartik, I asked him his complete name again with his surname he said I won't tell.
Then he said I won't tell you anything.

Is this how you deal with your customer?
Is this how you talk to women?
Spoilt my Birthday.
I wish the sender had chosen a better and more professionally caring and human oriented website to send love through flowers to me.

THIS HAS BEEN MY WORST EXPERIENCE IN TERMS OF GIFTS RECIVED FROM OVERSEAS!.

DOES YOUR COMPANY CARE?

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kids Friendly place.
This place is divided into different sections, the entry is free.

*Fish park - this park is quite big and has 3 gates,
The first half has fish tanks, selfie point and a fountain
Currently there are only few fishes, the fountain is shut and the empty tanks are not maintained well (due to COVID)

*The cricket ground - usually there is local cricket match on weekends, chairs are provided for audience.

*Kids play area- there are slides, swings, and play area for kids.

*Open Gym- they have a gym area near the second gate, which is currently closed for public, equipments are mainted nicely.

*Walking / jogging track - there is a long walking and jogging track around the park, local residents usually come visit for morning and evening walks

*Accessibility - park is partially Accessibility as there are stairs in some parts of the park. This place is ideal for kids, family and senior citizens.
The fish park gate is accessible but to reach the other area it is ideal to use the second gate which has a slope.

featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended a wedding at Kora Kendar, and while the overall ambience was pleasant, I was disappointed with the lack of proper washroom facilities. Having previously visited for a garba event a few years ago, I expected improvements in this area, but unfortunately, it was still a major inconvenience.

The venue relies on portable restrooms, commonly known as porta-potties, which are known for their discomfort and lack of cleanliness. This arrangement was highly inconvenient, especially during a wedding where guests require comfortable and hygienic washroom facilities. The absence of proper washroom amenities significantly affected the overall experience.

However, it's worth noting that Kora Kendar does excel in terms of ambiance. The atmosphere created for the event was enjoyable, and the management seemed to have put effort into creating a pleasant environment for the guests. The overall decor and arrangements were satisfactory, contributing to the positive aspects of the venue.

Despite the shortcomings in washroom facilities, Kora Kendar may still be a suitable choice for events like garba or weddings, provided that alternative arrangements are made for washroom facilities. It would greatly enhance the overall experience and ensure the comfort of guests.

featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Rambade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently stayed at Fisherman Village for a monsoon staycation, and it turned out to be a really refreshing and peaceful experience. The moment we entered the property, the entire place felt calm, scenic, and surrounded by nature. Since we visited during the rainy season, everything looked extra beautiful — lush greenery, cloudy weather, the peaceful lake view, and ducks swimming around made the atmosphere feel straight out of a nature retreat.

One of the best parts of the stay was the ambience. The property has a very relaxing vibe, perfect for taking a break from the city rush. Sitting near the lake with light rain and cool weather felt extremely soothing. The view throughout the property was beautiful, especially during the evenings and early mornings. If you enjoy nature, monsoon is definitely the best time to visit.❤️

The food was also very good. The meals were fresh, tasty, and comforting, which added a lot to the overall experience. The staff was polite and welcoming, and the stay overall felt smooth and comfortable.✨

What we loved most was how peaceful and well-maintained the place felt. Whether it was walking around the property, enjoying the lake view, or simply relaxing with family and friends, the entire experience was memorable.🫶🏼

Overall, it was a wonderful staycation experience with beautiful views, good food, and a calm atmosphere. We genuinely enjoyed our stay and would definitely love to visit again, especially during the monsoon season. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway near nature.👌

featured_reviews.name: Isha shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had such a lovely experience at Fisherman Village Resort! 🌴✨
The entire vibe of the place was peaceful, relaxing, and perfect for a short getaway. The property is beautiful, well-maintained, and the atmosphere genuinely makes you feel refreshed. Food, ambience, and overall hospitality were really good.

A special mention to one of the staff members who was extremely patient, polite, and helpful throughout our stay. They handled everything so calmly and made sure we were comfortable the entire time. Staff like that truly make a place memorable.

Thank you for such a nice experience would definitely love to visit again! 💛

featured_reviews.review_text:
It's 2 stops ahead of virar, which can be a nightmare to travel to, plus the owner kept on suggesting us the expensive opt we had a simple request that we need our dinner served at 12:00 as few ppl in our grp were fasting, he first insisted that we take fish [as it costs more]

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stayed at Fisherman Village Resort recently. The place looks nice and the location is good, but a few things spoiled the trip.
The pool smelled strongly of chlorine and felt over-chlorinated. Also saw broken tiles inside the pool — not safe.
Food was disappointing for the price. Most gravies tasted the same (sweet and very red), and the bar had limited options with high prices.
Room was just okay. AC was leaking, the TV switchboard wasn’t fixed, and we heard a sparking noise from TV switch— that felt unsafe.
Room rate only includes breakfast, so you’ll pay extra for lunch and dinner.
